summary: Dung 1995 supplies exactly the formal vocabulary for the 'synthesis competence' node: an argumentation framework AF = (AR, attacks) treats answers as abstract atoms linked by a binary attack relation, with no internal structure, weight, or truth value. Admissibility (a conflict-free set that defends every member against all attackers) is the core rationality constraint; on top of it Dung defines a lattice of semantics with different guarantees: preferred extensions (maximal admissible sets; always at least one exists, but symmetric conflicts like the Nixon diamond yield several, so credulous justification is non-unique), stable extensions (conflict-free sets attacking every outside argument; strictly stronger than preferred and may fail to exist at all), and the grounded extension (least fixed point of the characteristic function F_AF(S) = {A | A acceptable wrt S}; always unique, but can be empty — the skeptical adjudicator may justifiably endorse nothing when two agent answers attack each other symmetrically). Complete extensions bridge the two: every preferred extension is complete, and the grounded extension is the least complete one. The key coincidence result for adjudication design: well-founded frameworks (no infinite attack chains) have exactly one extension that is simultaneously grounded, preferred, and stable — the formal condition under which conflict adjudication is unambiguous. Equally important for the note: the framework deliberately does NOT model evidential weight, attack strength, truth, or probabilistic confidence — Dung himself lists differentiating attack strength as necessary future work. Consequence for the research problem: Dung-style adjudication can tell a synthesizer which set of conflicting agent answers is defensible, but it cannot break symmetric ties (two mutually attacking answers produce two preferred extensions and an empty grounded one); whatever breaks the tie — retrieval of external evidence, in our mechanism — is precisely what the formalism lacks and what retrieval-mediated Q/A supplies. The wave-1 combined Dung+Shapiro packet failed with zero evidence (blocked, 'Exceeded maximum output retries'), so this packet is the sole source for the Dung half.
